== Summary ==
Lossless page extract from the complete official Set 9 PDF [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005193358id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-9.pdf archived at 2021-10-05T19:33:58Z]. Extract pages 1 and 2 are original pages 1 and 4 respectively. Original embedded images, vector text and icons are retained without rasterization or lossy recompression; each extracted page renders and extracts text exactly as its original page. Complete original: seven readable pages, 123,968,985 bytes, SHA-256 <code>1a4a0ce08ac504a5cfe79b59c43c62f076af76b1c0014bcf4525bd39603dcb98</code>. The complete source exceeds the Wiki upload limit and remains preserved unchanged in the source archive. The capture dates this copy, not the unknown first publication day. Extract SHA-256 <code>f77fcff876fa66bc727e3121270b09014058d767a3b159af31b044e558d1dd7e</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd.; published by the Players Committee.
